// Generated by XNA Reborn. Opt-in window extras: HighDpi.
// The game keeps its own resolution as the back buffer. This file never touches gameplay code.
using System;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using Microsoft.Xna.Framework;

namespace XnaReborn.Modern
{
    internal static class ModernExtras
    {
        /// <summary>Call once after the game is created and before it runs.</summary>
        internal static void Attach(Game game)
        {
            if (game == null)
            {
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(game));
            }
        }
    }

    internal static class HighDpi
    {
        // Runs before Main, so before any window exists. Windows only; later calls and other systems do nothing.
        [ModuleInitializer]
        internal static void Enable()
        {
            if (!OperatingSystem.IsWindows())
            {
                return;
            }

            try
            {
                SetProcessDpiAwarenessContext(new IntPtr(-4)); // per-monitor v2
            }
            catch (DllNotFoundException)
            {
            }
            catch (EntryPointNotFoundException)
            {
            }
        }

        [DllImport("user32.dll")]
        private static extern bool SetProcessDpiAwarenessContext(IntPtr value);
    }
}
